pairs.subject: video-assembly
pairs.evidence: tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:9 The sidecar's only output is one sentence of PCM with optional mouth shapes on a live stdio stream, and git grep over every tracked file in tools/voice found no hit for video, ffmpeg, multitrack, storyboard or music, so nothing here assembles material into a cut.

techniques.evidence: tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/visemes.py:408 Mouth-shape timing comes from the engine's own printed token batches and durations, with no speech recognition round trip; only the spoken index space exists, so authored and spoken alignments cannot be confused. The spans do not label their index space.

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/engine.py:172 Move one holds for referenced inputs: a missing or wrong voices file makes the voice dead with a named reason and no fallback. Move two has no composition source to lint. A zero-sample render has no guard; see notes.

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/visemes.py:167 No clip has a mark or a stored offset and there is no correction control; the only sync adjustment is this fixed, measured 55 ms lead applied at the source.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:11 A failed line leaves as a protocol error; this context has no cut or working surface on which a gap could be drawn.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:17 One ordered stream of sentences, with no lanes, ruler or timeline surface.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:114 Nothing is compiled from a composition, and a render is one sentence at faster than real time, so there is no expensive export to defer.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:32 No generator emits sound jointly with picture; the voice is a stored asset selected by file and sid, which the technique's own exclusion covers.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:36 The only timeline here is a single sentence's mouth shapes; there are no act turns, chapters or other structural markers.

pairs.registryProposal: alignment-names-its-text only names character-indexed alignments returned by a synthesiser. An engine that exposes token ids and per-token durations, as here, has a single spoken index space and could be named as a case where the authored-versus-spoken choice does not arise.
